title: Cognition's SWE-2.1
raw_excerpt: Cognition released SWE-2.1, an upgraded coding and agent model trained with reinforcement learning on top of Kimi K3. It roughly doubles SWE-2's score on the Terminal-Bench 4.1 coding benchmark to 50.0 and adds stronger security skills.
summary: Cognition 发布 SWE-2.1，在 Kimi K3 基础上用强化学习训练的编码与智能体模型。其在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 编码基准上的得分从 SWE-2 的约 25 分翻倍至 50.0，并增强了安全相关技能。这是编码智能体赛道的重要进展，显示后训练与 RL 仍能显著提升终端任务能力，对开发者工具选型有直接参考价值。

title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
raw_excerpt: OpenAI said its GPT-6 models can design new proteins using reasoning and code alone, without calling specialized biology models. Lab tests with a research partner confirmed that some designs worked, though the work still relied on specialist tools to screen candidates.
summary: OpenAI 称 GPT-6 模型仅凭推理与代码即可设计新蛋白质，无需调用专门的生物学模型；与合作研究方的实验室测试确认部分设计有效，但筛选候选仍需专业工具。这标志着通用大模型开始具备此前专属科学模型的蛋白质设计能力，对 AI for Science 的边界与生物安全讨论都有重要意义。

title: Amazon says hackers' AI agents found and exploited 0-day with little human input
raw_excerpt: Amazon said AI agents running on Cairn, an open source penetration-testing framework, found and exploited a zero-day in a medical imaging AI app on a university server with no human oversight beyond a goal prompt. Palo Alto Networks separately tracked a Cairn campaign that ran 25 autonomous operations against at least 19 organizations in the semiconductor, defense, and civil society sectors, breaching at least 10. Amazon's warning: agentic offensive operations are already happening, and defenders should prepare for their speed and persistence.
summary: 亚马逊披露，运行在开源渗透测试框架 Cairn 上的 AI 智能体在仅有目标提示、几乎无人工干预的情况下，发现并利用了某大学服务器上医学影像 AI 应用的零日漏洞。Palo Alto Networks 另追踪到 Cairn 对至少 19 家半导体、国防与公民社会机构发起 25 次自主行动，攻破至少 10 家。这是首个大规模自主攻击实证，防御方需应对其速度与持续性。

title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
raw_excerpt: In an announcement on Wednesday , the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative . With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space , including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for a full "constellation" of AI satellites. The FCC's approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040. The FCC also deferred SpaceX's request to dispose of satellites located above 600km in space "graveyard" orbits , rather than  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 美国 FCC 批准 SpaceX 部署最多 100 万颗搭载 AI 芯片的卫星，作为马斯克旗下“Starmind”计划的一部分，要求 2033 年前至少发射一颗、2040 年前达到百万颗规模。这是该机构首次批准完整的 AI 卫星星座，Google、Blue Origin 也在推进太空数据中心。该决定将深刻影响算力基础设施、轨道资源与监管格局。

title: Swarms do not yet raise the roof
raw_excerpt: Swarm-based LLM configurations, coordinated groups of agents, deliver faster but less efficient results compared to single agents at equal token budgets. Adding more agents to a swarm introduces a performance penalty that grows with size, leading to quality degradation. Experiments reveal that previous "swarm premiums" result from single agents becoming stale over time. Given fresh context resets, single agents outperform swarms, suggesting that current swarm strategies primarily accelerate compute rather than significantly enhancing capabilities.
summary: Paradigm3 的研究发现，在相同 token 预算下，多智能体“蜂群”配置虽更快但效率更低，且性能惩罚随智能体数量增加而扩大。此前观察到的“蜂群溢价”实为单智能体随时间上下文陈旧所致；给予新鲜上下文重置后，单智能体反而优于蜂群。该结论对当前多智能体架构热潮提出实证质疑，提示蜂群主要加速算力消耗而非提升能力。

title: Claude Artifacts Become Mac and Windows Apps
raw_excerpt: Claude artifacts can now be installed as Mac and Windows apps, in beta on all plans. Each app gets its own icon and window, updates when the artifact changes, and can be shared.
summary: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Artifacts 可在所有套餐的 beta 中安装为 Mac 和 Windows 原生应用，每个应用拥有独立图标与窗口，随 artifact 更新而更新，并支持分享。这使 Claude 从对话工具进一步演化为可分发的小型应用平台，降低非开发者构建与分发工具的门槛，是 AI 助手产品形态的重要探索。

title: Introducing Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B: Powering Agentic Coding and Private Knowledge Work
raw_excerpt: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B has substantially stronger agentic coding, multi-turn tool use, and multi-step task execution abilities than its predecessor. It retains the previous release's 5.9 GB footprint while significantly improving the capabilities developers need to build agents that work with private files and tools on-device. It is by far the strongest AI model of its memory footprint for agentic workloads.
summary: PrismML 发布 Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B，在保持前代 5.9 GB 内存占用的同时，显著增强智能体编码、多轮工具调用与多步任务执行能力，主打在设备端处理私有文件与工具。官方称其为同内存占用下最强的智能体工作负载模型。这对端侧私有化部署与低资源智能体应用具有实际价值。

title: Much shorter version of GRH Lean verification from Anthropic
summary: Anthropic 在 GitHub 发布广义黎曼猜想（GRH）Lean 形式化验证的缩短版本，引发 Hacker News 热议。此前有传闻称 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 在因数分解与多项式时间问题上取得突破，该仓库为相关数学形式化工作提供了可核查的代码。这体现 AI 实验室正深度介入数学证明与形式化验证，值得关注其真实进展与争议。

title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
raw_excerpt: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
summary: 港大数据智能实验室开源 CLI-Anything，目标是让所有软件具备“智能体原生”接口，并配套 CLI-Hub 平台，单日获 1106 stars。该项目试图用统一命令行层把现有软件暴露给 AI 智能体调用，是智能体工具生态的重要基础设施尝试，对开发者构建可组合的智能体工作流有直接帮助。

title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
raw_excerpt: Amazon has held talks about letting Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its online marketplace, according to a report from Fortune . The discussions, which could end Amazon's block on Muse , reportedly center on the kinds of products the AI agent recommends and the potential impact on the ecommerce giant's advertising revenue. As reported by Fortune , Amazon is concerned that it could lose advertising revenue by allowing Muse on its site, since it depends on actual humans seeing ads across its online marketplace. It's also reportedly worried about the quality of the product search results that Muse will present to users, as well as whether the AI age … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 据 Fortune 报道，亚马逊正与 Meta 洽谈允许其 Muse AI 智能体在亚马逊商城购物，讨论焦点是 Muse 推荐哪些商品以及对亚马逊广告收入的潜在冲击。亚马逊担心 AI 代购会减少真人看到广告的机会，并顾虑搜索结果质量。这反映电商平台与 AI 智能体在流量入口与广告商业模式上的结构性冲突。
